payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sorts four stick lengths, then computes max of (a0+a1-a2, a1+a2-a3) to determine if any triple forms non-degenerate, degenerate, or impossible triangle via index trick.
payload.rationale: Solution sorts input and uses a derived inequality check on adjacent triples, avoiding exhaustive enumeration. This aligns with sorting_custom_key as it leverages sorting to reduce problem complexity.
